summary: Syntec Optics Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing an underwritten public offering of 2,857,142 shares at $7.00 per share, with a 30-day option for additional 428,571 shares. Gross proceeds ~$20M; net proceeds intended for acquisitions, working capital, debt repayment; includes customary lock-ups and a 90-day issuance standstill. This is a capital raise, not a transformative special situation. [Non-US filing not applicable.] Watch for closing on April 30, 2026.
